contact.method: scripts/measure-garments.py contact_report on the named _REGION triangles of the exported skinned mesh. Count each plate/carrier pair when at least one child triangle crosses a parent triangle. Sample rest and six equally spaced phases per exported clip. This checks attachment contact at the sampled frames. It does not measure skin penetration depth, continuous contact, or plate-to-plate collision.

fixedCameraComparison.method: Load both game GLBs through GLTFLoader. Keep every body, head, eye, claw and toe region identical in the two source recipes after excluding growth metadata on their carriers. The control carries the 15 original fitted dorsal scutes from the painted porter. The growth build has the 70 generated cage plates. Use a 2.45 m orthographic vertical span at 540 by 540 pixels, ground fixed, camera target [0,0.98,0] metres. Use unlit GLB region IDs for visible-area counts and a single unlit material for silhouette masks. Per-file mesh simplification can slightly change unchanged regions.

body.origin: Original ridgeback turnaround already shipped in this repository

head.origin: Original four-view illustration generated with ImageGen for this MIT project. No third-party input image. Individual head, bill, cheek, brow and crest volumes were traced from this sheet and then fitted with separate physical eyes and horns.

platePigment.origin: Original four-swatch keratin albedo generated with ImageGen for this MIT project. No third-party input image. Each plate carries a swatch and a tint and follows the same growth coordinates as the editable shell.

knownLimitations: The original painted shoulder shows horizontal streaking on the exposed inner joint in rear-quarter Reach. A small area at the top of the original mantle also retains pale pink source paint.
The test compares available geometry, silhouette and attachment behavior. It does not establish visual parity with the private reference or comparable editor coverage.
